name: forward_inventory
query:
select
      to_regclass('supabase_migrations.schema_migrations') is not null as ledger_present,
      exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='supabase_migrations' and table_name='schema_migrations' and column_name='name') as ledger_has_name_column,
      coalesce((select array_agg(version::text order by version) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations), '{}'::text[]) as ledger_versions,
      to_regclass('public.packet_render_jobs') is not null as prereq_packet_render_jobs,
      to_regclass('public.consumer_pending_screening_results') is not null as prereq_consumer_pending_screening_results,
      to_regclass('public.consumer_briefcase_items') is not null as prereq_consumer_briefcase_items,
      to_regclass('public.screening_sessions') is not null as prereq_screening_sessions,
      to_regclass('public.clinic_events') is not null as prereq_clinic_events,
      exists(select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='enqueue_packet_render_job') as prereq_enqueue_packet_render_job,
      exists(select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='consumer_packet_payment_authority') as prereq_consumer_packet_payment_authority,
      exists(select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='rcap_onboarding_prefill_supersede_prior_applied') as prior_20260822180000,
      to_regclass('public.clinic_cases') is not null as prior_20260825120000,
      exists(select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='clinic_is_event_staff') as prior_20260825121000,
      exists(select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='clinic_reserve_packet_credit') as prior_20260825122000,
      to_regclass('public.participant_claim_events') is not null as sig_20260828100000,
      to_regclass('public.participant_privacy_requests') is not null as sig_20260830120000,
      exists(select 1 from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where version='20260901115000') as sig_20260901115000,
      exists(select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='get_consumer_packet_verification_authority') as sig_20260901120000,
      to_regclass('public.consumer_artifact_download_grants') is not null as sig_20260901130000,
      exists(select 1 from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where version='20260901140000') as sig_20260901140000,
      exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='clinic_events' and column_name='jurisdiction') as sig_20260903120000,
      exists(select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='finalize_sponsored_packet_generation_if_verified') as sig_20260903130000,
      to_regclass('public.sponsored_packet_render_routes') is not null as sig_20260906120000,
      exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='consumer_packet_artifact_provenance' and column_name='superseded_artifacts') as sig_20260906130000,
      exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='consumer_briefcase_items' and column_name='regular_price_cents') as sig_20260917090000
